upcoming.title: Annual Sportsmen Banquet
upcoming.description: Our flagship annual celebration! The Sportsmen Banquet is our biggest community event of the year, featuring a full dinner, social gathering, and a massive raffle with dozens of premium firearms, sporting gear, and door prizes.
upcoming.extraNote: Tickets sell out early every year—Stay tuned for when tickets go on sale!

upcoming.title: Annual Buck Pole
upcoming.location: 📍 Arenac County Fair Grounds Event Center | Standish, MI
upcoming.description: Bring your firearm deer season harvest to the Fair Grounds in Standish! Join fellow hunters to hang your buck, compare antlers, win contest prizes, and celebrate Opening Day traditions. The event is put on by the American Legion Post 104 of Standish with support from the Sterling Sportsmen's Club and other local organizations.

past.title: Youth Deer Hunt Buck Pole
past.description: Supporting Michigan's next generation of hunters! We sponsor youth hunters during Michigan's early youth deer season, encouraging safe hunting habits and conservation traditions.
